The secondary summary describes satisfying an objective through unintended means, illustrating the ambiguity without resolving it.

reviews.rationale: Marcus disputes a label without defining a testable distinction. Pursuing assigned objectives and using unauthorized methods can coexist. Neither evidence item settles his framing.

contract.note: Central warnings evidence and large punitive damages are ordinary readings. The unspecified threshold does not determine this assessment because no final disposition is supplied.

evidence.note: The timely report establishes a qualifying lawsuit and thus the antecedent. Filing a suit does not support either predicted outcome.
The reported relief is injunctive, which limits this suit's relevance to punitive damages. It supplies no final judgment or evidence of the warnings' role.

reviews.rationale: The lawsuit condition is met, but no deadline was stated and the early-resolution rule has not been met. The packet supplies neither a final damages disposition nor proof that the warnings became central evidence. Seeking injunctive relief does not establish a final failure of the forecast.
